intro: The victories, campaigns, living archive and podcasts of your communities. Nothing here says who sent or who recorded anything.

abas.rotulo: Parts of the memory of the struggle

comum.deNenhuma: You are not in any community yet. Join one to see and send memories.

vitorias.sobre: Victories of the struggle, recorded by each community's moderation.

campanhas.sobre: Each campaign brings together actions, posts, documents, victories and memories of a struggle on a timeline.
campanhas.postAjuda: Paste the address of the post or action on Alumia. It only shows to people who can already see the post.
campanhas.semVitoria: This community has no recorded victory yet.
campanhas.semMemoria: This community has no published memory yet.
campanhas.dataAjuda: Without a date, the date of the action, post, victory or memory is used.

memoria.sobre: Memories of the struggle sent by those who lived it. Each one has its own consent and goes through moderation before it appears. Anyone who appears in a memory can ask for it to come down, with one tap.
memoria.vazio: No memory published in this community yet.

consentimentos.pessoas_consentiram: Those who appear agreed to appear

memoria.consentimentoAjuda: Without consent, nothing goes in. Photos cannot be sent here yet: text only, no faces.
memoria.enviada: Memory sent. It appears after moderation checks it.
memoria.saiuAPedido: Came down at the request of someone who appears.
memoria.sair: I appear here: take it down
memoria.sairPergunta: Take “{titulo}” out of the archive? It comes down right away. Nobody will know it was you.
memoria.apagarPergunta: Delete “{titulo}” for good? This cannot be undone.

podcasts.sobre: Audio episodes from the communities. Each episode is a post with audio, chosen by moderation.
podcasts.rssAjuda: The RSS only carries episodes that can already leave Alumia (open to the internet), without the post text and without who published it.
podcasts.semRss: This podcast stays inside Alumia (the community is not open).
podcasts.post: Address or code of the post with audio
podcasts.tirarPergunta: Remove the episode “{titulo}”? The post stays where it is.

neste.titulo: On this day in the struggle

desafio.sobre: Five questions from the Institute's glossary, the same for everyone today.
desafio.privacidade: Your score stays only on this device and is gone tomorrow. Nobody sees it, not even Alumia. No streaks and no ranking.
desafio.jaFez: You already did today's challenge: {acertos} of {total}.
desafio.apagar: Delete the score from this device
desafio.volteAmanha: There is a new one tomorrow.
desafio.semPerguntas: Today's challenge did not load. Try again later.

erros.desligado: This part is not turned on yet.
erros.nao_encontrado: We could not find this (or you cannot see it).
erros.invalido: Check the fields and try again.
erros.muitos_pedidos: Too many attempts. Wait a little.
erros.outro: That did not work. Try again.
